settings.intro: The conversion runs as a GitHub Actions workflow in the repository that hosts this page. Everything below is stored only in this browser.
settings.tokenSteps:
• Open GitHub → Fine-grained tokens → Generate new token.
  • Repository access: Only select repositories → this repository.
  • Permissions: Actions → Read and write. Nothing else is needed.
  • Generate, copy it, paste it above.
settings.cookies: YouTube cookies (needed to pass YouTube's bot check)
settings.cookieSteps:
• Sign in to YouTube in your browser, ideally with a spare account.
  • Export cookies for youtube.com in Netscape format, for example with the “Get cookies.txt LOCALLY” extension.
  • In the repository: Settings → Secrets and variables → Actions → New repository secret, named YT_COOKIES, and paste the whole file.
  • Refresh the secret when runs start failing with “Sign in to confirm you're not a bot”.
